subject: Need to get the coefficients of the splines / regression in qplot, is  there way?

messages.author: 0a7ad9eae0840ca4
messages.subject: Need to get the coefficients of the splines / regression in qplot, is  there way?
parts:
Hi,

Is anybody knows how to get the coefficients of the in y~ns(x,3)), see
example below.

library(splines)
library(ggplot2)

qplot(dbh, Height, data = forests, geom = c("point", "smooth"),
method = "lm")

qplot(dbh, Height, data = forests, geom = c("point", "smooth"),
method = "lm", formula = y ~ ns(x,5))

# Multiple Linear Regression Example
fit <- lm(Height ~ dbh + dbh + dbh, data=forests)

summary(fit) # show results

Need help in "fit <- lm(Height ~ dbh + dbh + dbh, data=forests)?????"
to correspond in the y ~ns(x,3).

Is there a way to print these coefficients in the qplot? e.g. y = ** + **x ...

Thanks. Noli


Thanks, Noli

messages.author: ba9318fcb03a20d0
messages.subject: Re: Need to get the coefficients of the splines / regression in qplot, is       there way?
parts:
Hi Noli,
You can get them separately using:
coef(lm(Height~ns(dbh,5), data=forests))
should give you the intercept and the regression coefficients. To get
the spline basis,
just use ns(forests$dbh,5). You can add an annotation layer to put them
in the plot.

Nicholas
